xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5480: docs: quickstart install paths

references.label: PAN-5499 Getting Started accuracy audit (runs after this)
PAN-5543 overdeck up treats ~/.local/bin/overdeck as the desktop app

narratives.Problem: The homepage advertises `curl -fsSL https://overdeck.ai/install | sh` and `overdeck up`, but quickstart.mdx shows neither. The quickstart also shows a nonexistent `overdeck work` verb, says to swap models mid-conversation (a started conversation keeps its model), claims inline tool installs that do not exist, says Node 22+ (the CLI needs 22.16), lists tools `pan install` never installs, calls the macOS dmg universal (it is arm64 only), and uses em dashes. features/workspaces.mdx links a nonexistent /quickstart#planning-session anchor.
narratives.Proposal: Replace quickstart.mdx with the exact After text in the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-5480.md, W1): try with npx, install with the script then `overdeck up`, the Herdr/`overdeck install` note, corrected requirements, What happens next with the handoff fix, npm install (headless and full setup) with `overdeck start PAN-123`, desktop downloads, architecture, and a Get help section. Point the dead anchor in features/workspaces.mdx at /features/planning. Validate with mint@4.3.49 validate, broken-links and broken-links --check-anchors, and npm run lint:docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code changes; the `overdeck up` desktop-app misdetection is tracked in #5543.
- No edits to the install script in this repo or in overdeck-landing.
- No docs.json change and no new pages.
- No line-by-line audit of What happens next steps 1 to 4, the board paragraph or Architecture at a glance beyond dash removal; #5499 audits them after this merges.
- No new screenshots; the two existing ThemedImage blocks stay unchanged.
- No fixes to the other pre-existing broken anchors reported by broken-links --check-anchors.
- No changelog.d entry (no behavior change).

autoDecisions.summary: Rewrite the install sections fully, fix the two comment items, remove every dash on the page, and leave the substance of steps 1 to 4, the board paragraph and the architecture paragraph to #5499.
autoDecisions.rationale: #5499 explicitly audits quickstart.mdx after this PR merges; the issue's own scope is install paths plus the two comment fixes, and the dash ban applies to the whole touched page.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the homepage's two-command path (install script, then `overdeck up`) and add one paragraph saying `overdeck up` does not install Herdr, so run `overdeck install` once.
autoDecisions.rationale: Code shows `up` never installs Herdr (src/lib/herdr-setup/ensure.ts) and agents need it, but `overdeck install` is interactive and slow, so it should not be a silent third mandatory step; the Get set up card shows `pan install` when Herdr is missing.
src/cli/node-preflight.ts sets MIN_MINOR = 16 because node:sqlite needs 22.16+; the install script's major-only check is looser than the real requirement.

autoDecisions.summary: Tell users to re-run the script to upgrade; do not mention `pan update`.
autoDecisions.rationale: The script is idempotent and installs @latest into the same prefix; `pan update` may install into a different npm prefix.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the dead /quickstart#planning-session link in features/workspaces.mdx by pointing it at /features/planning.
autoDecisions.rationale: mint broken-links --check-anchors reports it on the baseline; it is a link to this page, and the issue asks for related pages to link correctly.

autoDecisions.summary: File the `overdeck up` misdetection as #5543 instead of fixing it here, and phrase `overdeck up` only as 'starts the dashboard and opens it in your browser'.
autoDecisions.rationale: This is a docs-only issue; that phrasing is true on both the normal and the misdetected path.
